title: Bo and Pip's Moon Mango Dance

pages.Text: Meet Bo, a silly monkey with golden brown fur. His best friend is Pip, a little blue bird. They love adventures together.
pages.Prompt: A cheerful jungle clearing at sunrise. A small silly monkey with golden brown fur and a long curly tail stands next to a tiny round bird with bright blue feathers. Both are smiling at the viewer.

Lines.text: Hi! I'm Bo! Let's go on an adventure!

pages.Text: Bo and Pip look up at the sky. They want to find the magic mango tree that grows on the moon. Its fruits would be the yummiest ever.
pages.Prompt: Bo the golden brown monkey and Pip the tiny blue bird standing on a grassy hill, pointing up at a bright full moon in a starry sky. A faint sparkle hints at a tree on the moon.

Lines.text: Look, Pip! The moon is out tonight!
I want to find the mango tree that grows up there!

pages.Text: But oh no! A grumpy cloud floats in front of the moon. It hides the sky and makes everything dark. Bo and Pip cannot see the moon.
pages.Prompt: A gloomy sky with a large puffy grey cloud with a frowny face and crossed tiny arms blocking the moon. Bo the monkey and Pip the blue bird stand below looking worried.

Lines.text: Go away! No moon for anyone tonight!
We can't see our mango tree!

pages.Text: Pip has a clever idea. She sings a soft lullaby to the grumpy cloud. The song floats up like a gentle breeze.
pages.Prompt: Pip the tiny blue bird perched on Bo's shoulder, eyes closed, singing sweetly. The grumpy cloud listens, its frown beginning to soften. Soft musical notes swirl in the air.

Lines.text: Hush little cloud, the stars are near...

pages.Text: Then Bo tickles the grumpy cloud with his fast fingers. Tickle tickle tickle! The cloud starts to giggle. It cannot stay grumpy anymore.
pages.Prompt: Bo the golden brown monkey reaching up and tickling the bottom of the grumpy grey cloud with both hands. The cloud's mouth is open in a big laughing grin.

Lines.text: Tickle tickle tickle! Giggle, cloud, giggle!

pages.Text: The cloud laughs so hard it cries happy rain. Big drops fall down. Pip shakes her feathers and Bo splashes in the puddles.
pages.Prompt: Joyful scene of smiling raindrops falling from a happy cloud. Bo the monkey splashes in a puddle, and Pip the blue bird shakes her wings mid-air, both laughing.

Lines.text: It's happy rain! Look at the puddles!
I'm not grumpy anymore! Tee hee!

pages.Text: The cloud drifts away and the moon shines again. On it grows the mango tree, full of giant golden mangoes.
pages.Prompt: The grey cloud has floated to the side, revealing the bright full moon. On the moon sits a leafy tree heavy with huge golden mangoes. Bo and Pip gaze up in wonder.

Lines.text: There it is! The moon mango tree!
The mangoes are huge and golden!

pages.Text: Bo and Pip dance together under the glowing moon. Then they share the biggest, juiciest moon mango. It tastes like sweet dreams and starlight.
pages.Prompt: Bo the golden brown monkey and Pip the tiny blue bird dancing happily on a grassy hill beneath the glowing full moon. Between them sits a giant sliced golden mango they are sharing.

Lines.text: This is the best mango in the whole universe!
Let's dance under the moon forever!
